properties.name: Hotel Quinta do Marco
properties.tip: Where we celebrate – and your home for the weekend.

properties.name: Praia Fluvial do Pego Fundo
properties.tip: A small sandy river beach with fresh water for a change – and a restaurant right there.

properties.name: Praia do Barril
properties.tip: Walk across the lagoon or hop on the cute little train – the kids will love it. At the end: a huge beach and the famous anchor cemetery.

properties.name: Praia do Ninho de Andorinha
properties.tip: A super small beach tucked between the cliffs – our little secret.

properties.name: Casa Velha
properties.tip: Amazing food: fresh oysters, chouriço and a cold beer with a view over the lagoon.

properties.name: Copos & Petiscos
properties.tip: Portuguese tapas (petiscos). One of the very first restaurants we went to together – and we keep coming back.

properties.name: O Teodósio
properties.tip: They only do one thing: grilled chicken with fries, rice and tomato salad. But they do it unbelievably well.

properties.name: Monterosa Olive Oil
properties.tip: An olive-oil farm near Moncarapacho. We haven’t been yet – it’s high on our list.

properties.name: Loulé Market
properties.tip: Loulé’s market hall, full of local produce. Another one on our to-visit list.

properties.name: Kayaking in Albufeira
properties.tip: Paddle along the golden cliffs and little caves around Albufeira.

properties.name: Boat trip from Albufeira
properties.tip: Sail along the coast from Albufeira marina – cliffs, caves and, with a bit of luck, dolphins.

properties.name: Aquashow Park
properties.tip: A big waterpark in Quarteira with slides for every age. Check the opening dates – waterparks close for the season around autumn.

properties.name: Zoomarine
properties.tip: Marine park and waterpark in one, near Guia. Check the opening dates before you go.

properties.name: Aqualand Algarve
properties.tip: Waterpark with some seriously big slides, near Alcantarilha. Check the opening dates before you go.

properties.name: Slide & Splash
properties.tip: One of the Algarve’s classic waterparks, near Lagoa. Check the opening dates before you go.

properties.name: Praia do Castelejo
properties.tip: Dark cliffs and a huge, wild beach on the west coast. It’s windy and the Atlantic is properly cold here – swim with care.

properties.name: Praia da Bordeira
properties.tip: Endless sand, dunes and a river winding into the sea. A west-coast favourite.

properties.name: Praia do Amado
properties.tip: A surfers’ paradise – rent a board or book a lesson and give it a go. The water is cold, the waves are great.

properties.name: Praia da Amoreira
properties.tip: Where the Aljezur river meets the ocean – calm lagoon on one side, wild Atlantic on the other.

properties.name: Praia de Odeceixe
properties.tip: A beautiful bay at the river mouth, right on the border of the Algarve and the Alentejo.

properties.name: Paddle boarding in Lagos
properties.tip: Paddle around the golden rock arches and grottoes of Ponta da Piedade.

properties.name: Lagos
properties.tip: A lovely old town to wander: whitewashed streets, cafés and a buzzing marina.
